title: Tensor product of exact dual pairs
statement:
Let $\mathcal C$ be a monoidal category [def-sfb-monoidal-category]. For $i=1,2$ let $P_i,Q_i$ be objects with $e_i:Q_i\otimes P_i\to\mathbf1$ and $b_i:\mathbf1\to P_i\otimes Q_i$ satisfying $(1_{P_i}\otimes e_i)(b_i\otimes1_{P_i})=1_{P_i}$ and $(e_i\otimes1_{Q_i})(1_{Q_i}\otimes b_i)=1_{Q_i}$, with canonical associators and unitors inserted. Then $P_1\otimes P_2$ and $Q_2\otimes Q_1$ form an exact dual pair. Its evaluation is
$$(Q_2\otimes Q_1)\otimes(P_1\otimes P_2)\cong Q_2\otimes(Q_1\otimes P_1)\otimes P_2\xrightarrow{1\otimes e_1\otimes1}Q_2\otimes P_2\xrightarrow{e_2}\mathbf1,$$
and its coevaluation is $\mathbf1\xrightarrow{b_1}P_1\otimes Q_1\xrightarrow{1\otimes b_2\otimes1}P_1\otimes P_2\otimes Q_2\otimes Q_1$, with the canonical reassociation.
